verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Auto Loader ('Incrementally and efficiently process new data files as they arrive in cloud storage') combined with Lakeflow pipelines for managed ETL orchestration and Structured Streaming for continuous event processing with sub-5ms latency, all running as managed/serverless services rather than customer-operated infrastructure. Ingestion connectors are also documented as a standard, managed offering. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that the ingestion pipelines require zero customer-managed infrastructure in practice, and community feedback flags general serverless 'surprise gotchas' that add some caveats to the fully hands-off claim.
